title: Piercing Frame Solo #040 (일반 허리 컷 · P50 정의형 · 콘로우 · 파스텔민트 · 메이크업 발칸글램 · 금속 로즈골드 · 공예 단일(Spanish Andalusian filigree) · 체형 아주 잘록한 허리·매끈한 배·넓은 힙 · 배꼽 링)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, waist shot. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed from the very top of her head down to just below her navel, the frame cutting off across her lower belly. Her face sits in the upper part of the frame, large enough to read every piercing, and her ear pieces are oversized so they read clearly at this distance. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Romanian woman — warm fair-olive skin, thick dark straight-edged brows, a heavy black liner smoked out at the outer corners, deep brown shadow blended up to the crease, long dense lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, sculpted contour, a deep red matte lip with a crisp edge, an intense, proud expression, soft pastel-mint-green hair styled in cornrows braided tight against the scalp. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain — a photograph of a real woman, not an illustration, not a render.

Piercings: An extreme, dense array of large real metal piercings: a thick rose-gold septum ring with a smaller rose-gold ring above it and two rose-gold rings through each nostril; a straight rose-gold bar across the bridge of the nose between the brows; three rose-gold pieces in a row along the outer half of each eyebrow, alternating small rings that pass through the brow skin with the skin visible through each loop and small round ball studs sitting on the skin; a rose-gold Medusa stud above the lips; a big rose-gold hoop, two smaller rings and a snake-bite ring on each side through the lower lip's edge, and a row of small hoops through the upper lip's edge; a rose-gold labret stud and two rings through the chin; a row of small rose-gold studs along each jaw; a curved row of small rose-gold studs along each cheekbone; on each ear a full dense row from lobe to top of oversized rose-gold hoops, thick bars and stretched plugs, the biggest hoops hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulders; and two fine rose-gold chains looping from the ear hoops to the nostril rings. A rose-gold ring passes through the rim of her navel, the navel itself a deep dimple set in the smooth swell of her belly. All jewelry is real rose gold, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Physique: a very narrow waist with a flat, smooth belly, wide hips and a full bust.

Body: Below the collarbones her whole body is painted in one traditional pattern: Spanish Andalusian filigree (a deep black ground with fine silver filigree in geometric star patterns), wide silver bands following the contours of the body, with geometric star filigree filling the space between bands, covering every inch of skin from the collarbones to the bottom of the frame without exception, the pattern reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Real skin on the face, ears and neck ends cleanly at the base of the neck and across both collarbones, and everything below it, down to the bottom of the frame, is the body treatment described above.

Pose: arms relaxed at her sides, shoulders level, head level toward the camera.

Lighting: pure pitch black background. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the makeup and the glints on every piece of metal read clearly; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
